_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

basic_movement_in_pool.name: Basic movement in pool
description: All special movement abilities (buttstomp, sidekick, double jump, copter ears, uppercut) are items in the pool that need to be unlocked.

block_destruction_in_pool.name: Block destruction in pool
description: Permissions for destroying specific obstruction blocks are items in the pool that need to be unlocked.

individual_level_unlock_keys.name: Individual level unlock keys
description: Unlock levels with individual keys rather than episode-specific progressive level unlock items.

allow_levels_out_of_order.name: Allow playing levels out of order
allow_levels_out_of_order.display_name: Allow playing levels out of order
description: Typically, reaching a specific level requires beating (and having access to) the prior levels in the same episode.
If this is enabled, you're allowed to play a level out of order by loading it through JCS
or by copying it onto your Home Cooked Levels list and playing it that way.
Simply playing through locked levels in an episode while ignoring location checks to reach the unlocked level
is not allowed, as that way you may gain access to weapons or weapon upgrades not available in your unlocked levels.
Doesn't do anything if levels are unlocked progressively, as you always have the ability to jump between episodes.

enable_tsf.name: Enable The Secret Files content
description: This includes the levels listed in The Secret Files category and the Lori character unlock.

enable_hh.name: Enable Holiday Hare '98 content
description: This includes the levels listed in the Christmas Chronicles category, but not the Lori character unlock.

enable_cc.name: Enable Christmas Chronicles content
description: This includes the levels listed in the Christmas Chronicles category and the Lori character unlock.
